title: R' Yochanan ben Ketzarta

paragraphs: Mentioned in Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:9, reporting in the name of R' Yonah. Hyman calls this a scribal error: the name should read R' Yitzchak ben Ketzarta, as in Rosh Hashanah, chapter 1, halakhah 1, at the additional printed page locator 2b, and Vayikra Rabbah 4:6.[^1][^2]

notes.text: שהש״ר/וו״ר are contextual work labels and 2:9/4:6 source pairs. כר״ה is כ + Rosh Hashanah, so as-in is not doubled. ה״א־ב: is interpreted as halakhah 1 plus additional historical page 2b, not halakhot 1–2 or a modern Bavli folio; corpus and edition are not freshly established.

Hyman’s scribal-error/should-read correction changes headed Yochanan to Yitzchak, not the Yonah reporting authority. The earlier note’s claim of Yonah correction is explicitly retired. All three personal-title abbreviations remain R', and the supplied source is unchanged.
